name: Not Georgia
source: You've just finished a code camp and moved to a new city for a fresh start in your life. Until you get on your feet you'll be staying with an old friend and exploring the city and job opportunities.
translation: 你刚结束一个编程训练营，为了开启人生新篇章搬到了新城市。在站稳脚跟之前，你会暂住在一位老朋友家，同时探索这座城市并寻找工作机会。
